'''TT-3P0''' was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-plated [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] that served the [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] gang [[TechTank]] at their [[TechTank shop|concealed base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After becoming embroiled in a gang war with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Noako]], the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] took shelter among TechTank. A group of Sinasu's agents traveled to the TechTank base with a cargo of [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragons]] for the crime lord and on their arrival, TT-3P0 was sent out to greet the agents.
